home.a: Friensys is a school ERP platform used by 300+ K-12 schools across India. It covers admissions, fees, attendance, exams, report cards, parent communications, transport, library, and HR — under one branded mobile app per school.

home.q: Where is my school's data hosted?
home.a: All Friensys customer data is hosted on AWS infrastructure in the Mumbai (ap-south-1) region — within India. Encryption at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.2+) are enabled by default.
Friensys is aligned with India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. We publish a DPDPA compliance statement and offer a Data Processing Agreement on request.

home.q: How is Friensys different from Kaksha or Parentsalarm?
home.a: Friensys is operations-first — fees, attendance, report cards, parent comms. We focus on admin-AI (AI for principals + accountants) rather than student-facing AI tutoring. We've been live with 300+ schools for 8 years.

pricing.a: School ERP pricing depends on student count, modules selected, and onboarding requirements. We share a tailored quote within 48 hours of a discovery call — no haggling, no surprises.
We run a full guided pilot for qualifying schools, with sample data, for two weeks. Book a demo to request a pilot.

pricing.q: Can I buy specific modules only?
pricing.a: Yes. Friensys is modular. Most schools start with Admissions, Fees, Attendance, and the Parent App, and add Transport, Library, Hostel, and HR over time.

security.q: How often is data backed up?
security.a: Automated daily backups with 30-day retention. Point-in-time recovery available on Enterprise plans.
Yes. Every user action that modifies records (fee deletion, marks edit, admission edit) is logged with timestamp, user, and reason.
